name: npubmail
description: Your agent's own email inbox, owned by a Nostr key. No signup, no password, no API key. Receive verification codes, read replies, send mail.
long_description: npubmail gives an AI agent a real email address (name@npubmail.com) whose only credential is a Nostr key kept on your machine. The agent can create disposable sender-locked aliases for signups, block until a verification code arrives, read mail (sealed to your key at rest), and send plain text. Receiving and replying are free; mailing someone new costs a few sats over Lightning, per message, with no account balance.

mailbox_name.description: Becomes <name>@npubmail.com if free. Optional; the npub address always works.
